description: Short name of the server, for example `artemis-test1`. The generated values do not use it further; it keeps the upstream inventory convention.
Public DNS name of the server. The Artemis URL and the LocalVC SSH URL are derived from it.
Database password. Generate a random value once and keep it: the database applies it only on first start.
Password of the internal `artemis_admin` account. Generate a random value once and keep it.
Key that signs login tokens; a long base64 value, for example from `openssl rand -base64 64`. Generate it once and keep it.
Contact e-mail address of this Artemis instance. It is also the git commit address, and notification e-mails are sent from it with a `+notification` suffix.
Organization operating this instance, shown in the installation information. Required.
Name of the responsible administrator, shown in the installation information. Required.
University or institution using this instance, shown in the installation information. Required.
Path on the server to the TLS certificate nginx serves; it must cover `SERVER_HOSTNAME`.
Path on the server to the private key of that certificate.
